events.text: Cutty Sark had become surplus to requirements by 1950.

events.text: She was temporarily moved first for a refit from February 1951.

events.text: She was moved to take part in the Festival of Britain at Deptford until October 1951.

events.text: The 800-ton tanker collided with Cutty Sark's bow in the Thames on 30 January 1952.
